licence.name: Macao driving licence (carta de condução de Macau), category B (light motor vehicle)

note: Read 2026-10-30. The Macao government portal's service pages, provided by the Transport Bureau (DSAT): to obtain a light motor vehicle category in the driving licence the applicant must be 18 (the first application for the driving exam); the renewal page gives the ages at which a licence for categories CICL, A and B is renewed as 40, 50, 60, 65, 70 and every 2 years after, so a licence first issued at 18 runs to 40 (untilAge, a reading of that schedule: the page states the renewal ages, not the first licence's end in words), with no term in years (null); the renewals aren't held. The fee: the Transport Bureau's Table of Fees and Charges (Tabela de Taxas e Preços, approved by Chief Executive's Order 525/2016, Boletim Oficial of 31 December 2016; its later amendments, 140/2018, 84/2019, 131/2019, 215/2022 and 214/2026, change articles 1, 2 and 24, not article 5) makes the issue of a Macao driving licence exempt (isento), held as a fee of nothing; its renewal costs MOP 400 and exchanging a licence issued elsewhere MOP 2,000 (with a 10% stamp duty), neither held; the driving exams' fees aren't held. Exchange: the direct-issue page names some issuers whose licences it exchanges without a test, but not as a complete list, so none is held. The identity card is the Identification Services Bureau's, the ids engine's.
